_comment: Win11Debloat configuration, tuned for a komorebi + yasb tiling desktop.
Passed to Win11Debloat.ps1 via -Config by scripts/debloat-windows.ps1.
Schema: {Version, Settings:[{Name, Value}]}. Names are Win11Debloat's own
parameter names without the leading dash. Every entry below is a real
flag from https://github.com/Raphire/Win11Debloat/wiki/Command-line-Interface
Do not add comment objects inside Settings - the script reads .Name/.Value
off every element, so a decorative entry becomes a null setting.
Grouped by intent:
tiling   DisableWindowSnapping/SnapAssist/SnapLayouts stop Windows from
fighting komorebi for window placement. HideTabsInAltTab matters
because Alt+Tab is remapped to komorebic cycle-focus.
taskbar  yasb is the real bar, so this one is stripped to the minimum.
HideTaskview removes a button for a feature komorebi replaced.
explorer sane defaults: real extensions, hidden files, opens on This PC.
privacy  telemetry, Bing in search, suggestion surfaces, lockscreen ads.
ai       the built-in Copilot/Recall surfaces. Unrelated to the coding
agents this repo installs - see docs/agents.md for those.
system   dark mode to match Tokyo Night, mouse acceleration off,
Fast Startup off (it skips a real shutdown, which confuses WSL2
and GPU drivers after an update).
App removal is deliberately NOT here. It lives behind -RemoveApps in the
wrapper so uninstalling software stays a separate, explicit decision.
